description.en: One tick of the lead («Штурман»): code reads the project/hub state and writes the brief with the identity first; the lead agent updates the tree and names proposals with evidence and a price; code records them in the road and evolve ledger (lane_pilot_lead_road, never the owner inbox), and closes the tick receipt with what it cost.
description.ru: Один тик Штурмана: код читает состояние проекта и хаба и пишет бриф с личностью первым блоком; агент-ведущий обновляет дерево и называет предложения с доказательством и ценой; код записывает их в дерево дороги и журнал эволюции (lane_pilot_lead_road, без карточек владельцу) и закрывает квитанцию тика с его ценой.

not_for: anything a person asks in a chat: the project calendar schedule and manual tick start it
posting cards into the owner inbox: proposals go only to the road and evolve ledger

projectId.note: optional project id when triggered from a project calendar schedule

tickId.note: the receipt row the service opened before the run (lane_pilot_lead_tick)

title.en: Read the hub and write the brief

nodes.rule: code: the identity (LEAD.md), every project in the lead's zone, the road tree, the open proposals, the exam per class, the budget left today; the brief is empty when the lead is off or over budget

title.en: The lead reads the state and proposes

nodes.prompt:
{{state.brief}}

Answer with the fields: summary (two or three sentences for the receipt), proposals (the list described above, at most the number the brief names; empty when nothing deserves the owner's morning), branches (new directions or options for the tree, not proposed today), deferred (what you looked at and left, with why), status (done, or blocked with blocked_reason when the state is unreadable).

title.en: Record the branches and the proposals

nodes.rule: code: new branches go into the tree; each complete proposal (class, why, evidence, cost) becomes a branch in state proposed; the rest is dropped with its reason
code: the tick's row gets what was proposed and deferred, the tokens and the cost

think.deferred: the SEO direction: no artifact yet

receipt.report:
Three projects, one stale branch.
Предложений: 1

test.live: switch lead.enabled on, run the project's lead-tick calendar row or start manually, and inspect proposals in the road / evolve ledger
